maddeler.e:
نتصادف (form VI)
# نَتَصَادَفُ (nataṣādafu) /na.ta.sˤaː.da.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَصَادَفَ (taṣādafa)
# نَتَصَادَفَ (nataṣādafa) /na.ta.sˤaː.da.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَصَادَفَ (taṣādafa)
# نَتَصَادَفْ (nataṣādaf) /na.ta.sˤaː.daf/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَصَادَفَ (taṣādafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
